insight: A 2021 from-scratch rewrite of Karpathy's original 2015 arxiv-sanity-preserver, slimmed down for scale and email digests.
name: arxiv-sanity-lite
tagline: Personalized arxiv reader by Andrej Karpathy.
description: Tag-and-track arxiv papers without drowning in the firehose. Train it on the topics you follow — edge inference, multi-agent harnesses, memory architectures — and it builds a personal feed.

changelog.summary: Archived — hosted service offline and the author stepped away from maintenance.

edge: Karpathy's own open-source, self-hostable tag-trained recommender — a tiny personal feed, not a hosted research suite.
